description: Ground truth valid values, formats, and ranges for pasl_policy columns. Used by score_mappings.py and data-quality validation.

POL_NO.notes: Zero-padded to 10 chars. No alphabetic prefix (contrast with PCL-/PCM- in PAS-M).

POL_NO_SEQ.notes: Staging dedup: ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pol_no ORDER BY pol_no_seq DESC). Only 00 and 01 exist in baseline data.

EFF_DT.description: Policy effective date in YYYYMMDD format

EXP_DT.description: Policy expiration date in YYYYMMDD format. Always 12 months after EFF_DT.

TERM_EFF_DT.description: Endorsement effective date. Equals EFF_DT on original records (POL_NO_SEQ=00). On endorsement records (POL_NO_SEQ=01), set to 30–180 days after EFF_DT.

embedded_comma.description: ', Unit N' suffix appended (breaks naive comma-delimited CSV parsers)

INS_ST.description: Insured state abbreviation (2-char US state code)
INS_ST.notes: This is the INSURED'S state, not the policy region code.

INS_SSN_LAST4.description: Last 4 digits of insured SSN (PII fragment)

PROD_CD.description: PAS-L native product codes — differ from canonical codes in other source systems
PROD_CD.notes: Resolved to canonical product_code via seed_pasl_lob_map in staging.

POL_STAT_CD.notes: PAS-L uses T (Terminated) where other systems use X (Expired). Resolved via seed_pasl_pol_stat_map.

WRTG_AGT.description: Writing agent code — same as AGCY_CD in PAS-L (agency code reused as writing agent)
WRTG_AGT.notes: Not a numeric agent ID. Do not map to canonical agent_id.

CHNL_CD.description: Distribution channel code. Valid values from pasl_chnl_cfg.dat DIST_CD column.

REGN_CD.description: Region code. Valid values from pasl_regn_cfg.dat REGN_CD column.

UW_TIER.description: Underwriting tier derived from RSK_SCR at policy issuance

ANNU_PREM_AMT.description: Annual written premium in DECIMAL(11,0) implied 2-decimal (integer cents). Divide by 100 for dollar value.

MNTHLY_PREM_AMT.description: Monthly premium = ANNU_PREM_AMT / 12 (rounded). Same cents encoding.

COV_A_LIM.description: COV_A per-occurrence limit in integer cents. Semantics by product: Dwelling (HO3/HO5) or Bodily Injury (PA/PAP).

COV_A_DED.description: COV_A deductible in integer cents. Semantics by product: Dwelling deductible (HO) or 0 for BI (PA).

COV_B_LIM.description: COV_B limit. Other Structures (HO, ~10% of COV_A) or Property Damage (PA).

COV_B_DED.description: COV_B deductible. 0 for both HO Other Structures and PA Property Damage.

COV_C_LIM.description: COV_C limit. Personal Property (HO, ~50% of COV_A) or Collision blanket (PA, always 0).

COV_C_DED.description: COV_C deductible. Personal Property deductible (HO) or Collision deductible (PA: $500/$1000/$1500).

COV_D_LIM.description: COV_D limit. Loss of Use (HO, ~20% of COV_A) or Comprehensive blanket (PA, always 0).

COV_D_DED.description: COV_D deductible. 0 for HO Loss of Use or Comprehensive deductible (PA: $100/$250/$500).

COV_E_LIM.description: COV_E limit. Liability ($100k or $300k for HO) or UM/UIM (same as COV_A BI for PA).

COV_F_LIM.description: COV_F limit. Medical Payments (HO: $1k or $5k) or PIP (PA: $5k/$10k/$20k).

ADDL_INS_1_NM.description: Additional insured 1 full name. Empty string = null.

ADDL_INS_1_REL.description: Additional insured 1 relationship code. Empty when ADDL_INS_1_NM is empty.

PRIOR_CARR_CD.description: Prior carrier 3-char abbreviation (first 2 chars of word 1 + first char of word 2 from carrier name). Empty string = no prior carrier.
PRIOR_CARR_CD.notes: Derived from PRIOR_CARR_NM in the upstream PAS source. Not a standardized industry code.

RSK_SCR.description: Underwriting risk score (0=highest risk, 100=lowest risk). Empty string = null.
RSK_SCR.notes: Profiler should detect as integer with occasional empty (null) values.

WINBK_FLG.description: Win-back eligible flag. Y/N boolean string.

CNCL_RSN_CD.description: Cancellation reason code. Empty string on active policies.
